scopeExplanation: Two Rust files plus six necessary governance/parity documents, eight scoped paths total. No product source edit has been made. Existing consumer WI1089 ten-file scope does not include the two Rust files; expanding it would itself violate the required authoritySource-only renewal segment. Use independent implementation WI1090 instead.
constraints: Every changedValues entry on the unique validated old-receipt-to-current-Contract amendment segment must be exactly /governanceProfile/materialInspectionReview/authoritySource with a real old/new value. Reject scope, acceptance, assurance, reviewer, residual-risk or any other field change anywhere on that segment, including change-and-revert. At least one authoritySource change is required.

Preserve current read_material_review_receipt invalid classification and all scanner Unknowns. A finite typed replacement proof authorizes only a NEW exact current-request decision; it grants no discharge from the old receipt.

Validate immutable historical receipt, raw and canonical digests, exact Summary pointer/history identity, repository/WI/base/source ancestry and historical profile reconstructed from the validated native amendment chain. Reject prepared-but-uncommitted, missing, broken, forked or foreign chains.

Require current Contract opt-in, current valid identity-bound native human review/authority, clean committed current source, no Finding, only permitted reviewable syntax Unknown with exact blob/hunk identity. Preserve self_declared assurance; no live grant or authenticated-human inference.

Projection and record call the SAME typed finite eligibility helper. Projection never accepts a generic read error; record recomputes the proof under the existing lifecycle lock and separately validates actual current decision input, reviewer, authoritySource, evidence references and all request/profile/scanner/policy digests.

No change to status_projection.rs is proposed: its existing material_review_decision_available consumption is the action-admission layer. All its existing !archived, !blocking and preflight_binding_current predicates remain. No finish/archive bypass is introduced.

Validation failure publishes neither a prepared transaction nor a new receipt. Once validated, use an immutable sealed prepared transaction and one atomic Summary pointer/history commit point, with recoverable precommit residue and no mutation of historical sidecars, pointers or amendment records.

Only exact uncommitted pending transaction continuation may resume, with all current identities revalidated and its original sealed receipt bytes/time/runtime reused. Committed replay, duplicate history, mismatched pending input/runtime/request, changed Summary, conflicting or corrupt prepared records remain rejected.

No source edit before actual native Contract review and checkpoint. Preserve pinned governance Runtime and delivered c960 source/CI; new executable adoption requires actual separate native environment/admission readback.

callGraph.projection: status_projection::project status -> material_review_gate_projection_with_contract_digest -> read_material_review_receipt (old remains invalid) + finite_authority_source_replacement_proof -> projection.review_decision_available -> existing status_projection.rs:1870 guards -> record_material_review_decision safe action
callGraph.record: record_work_item_material_review -> lifecycle lock -> fresh current Contract/request -> native require_current_action_admission -> SAME finite_authority_source_replacement_proof -> existing exact current decision validator -> sealed transaction -> immutable receipt -> atomic Summary pointer/history commit
callGraph.internalInterfaceProposal: fn finite_authority_source_replacement_proof(root: &Path, contract: &Contract, contract_digest: &Digest, request: &MaterialReviewRequest, summary_path: &Path) -> Result<Option<AuthoritySourceReplacementProof>, ObserverError>. Noneligible state cannot suppress receipt invalidity. No typed proof may come from matching error text.

failureAtomicity.model: Logical failure atomicity with durable prepared transaction; not a claim of physically atomic multi-file publication or zero crash residue.
failureAtomicity.preparation: After all eligibility/input/old-history checks, seal repository/WI/current Contract+request+profile, validated amendment tail and current human-review provenance, old Summary raw digest+old pointer, input digest, exact new receipt bytes including actual timestamp/runtime, and exact proposed Summary bytes/digest. Bounded strict nofollow/no-replace reads and writes; deterministic request-bound private transaction sidecar; reject incompatible existing pending state.
publicationOrder: Publish immutable prepared record using existing bounded capability directory and immutable writer.
Publish canonical new receipt with the sealed exact bytes, no replacement. Recheck immutable inputs and unchanged old Summary before commit.
Atomic Summary publication is the sole commit point: old pointer appended exactly once to validated history and current pointer set to new immutable receipt.
failureSemantics: Before Summary commit, current pointer/history remain old. Prepared/new receipt residue is pending evidence and grants no current material discharge. Preserve all canonical bytes.
Exact pending retry revalidates current admission, request, authority, chain, runtime and old/new Summary identity; resumes original sealed bytes rather than regenerating timestamps or receipts.

After an ambiguous commit result, compare canonical Summary and sealed receipt: exact new state means committed; exact old state means pending; anything else rejects as conflict. Do not report clean failure after an actual commit.
Fully committed record replay rejects and does not append duplicate history. No general reset/delete/revoke/import path.
failureAtomicity.faultInjection: Private cfg(test) dependency/failpoint seam in material_review.rs only; no production environment flag, public input, protocol or CLI/MCP schema bypass.

scenarios.expected: A complete native single-field chain plus current native human review admits a NEW exact decision; old receipt stays invalid and discharges no Unknown until pointer commit.
Scope/acceptance/reviewer/assurance/residual-risk/other field, mixed or reverted changes and direct unjournaled edits reject without writes.
